input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: No express liquidated damages clause exists, but Section 2.1 makes Customer unconditionally liable for USD 2,000,000 per year "on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights" — payment for Services not consumed and a minimum amount surviving termination, i.e. a Customer-payable penalty/minimum termination fee that the preferred position prohibits. It also conflicts with Section 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment). Only Customer-payable exposure is addressed; Customer-facing remedies (10.2, 19.4, 27.3) and service credits (1.5) are untouched. Per verifier feedback the redline is narrowed to strike only the penal mechanic, retaining the volume figure as a target so any volume-based pricing is preserved, and no longer reaches Order Form terms; fallback of a 3-month-fee early-termination cap is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Strike only the penal element of Section 2.1 (take-or-pay, no reduction/termination rights) and confirm no Customer-payable shortfall, liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination charge, keeping the volume figure intact.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages, penalties, or take-or-pay shortfall amounts are payable by Customer, so we have kept the USD 2,000,000 volume figure as a target but struck the take-or-pay mechanic and the removal of our reduction and termination rights. This also aligns Section 2.1 with Section 12.3, which records that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment; if a committed spend is commercially essential to the pricing, we can discuss an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: as a non-binding volume target. Customer is not liable for any take-or-pay or minimum-commitment shortfall, liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination charge, and Customer's reduction, non-renewal, and termination rights under this Agreement are unaffected.
